(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Pic The Gift is a B2B print-on-demand fulfillment company seeking a Junior Software Developer to maintain applications, troubleshoot technical issues, and support the transition from a legacy ERP to a custom-built system. The role involves developing business applications and working with the Senior Software Developer and CTO on business-focused software solutions.
Junior business application developer supporting custom ERP systems through coding, testing, SQL troubleshooting, and maintenance

Responsibilities:
• Assist with developing and improving business applications
• Test software and troubleshoot applications, order data, and integration issues
• Use SQL and reporting tools to investigate problems and identify solutions
• Maintain existing systems and support our custom ERP development

Requirements:
• 6 months to 2 years of software development or application support experience
• Experience with JavaScript, JSON/XML APIs, relational databases, and SQL
• Logical problem-solving skills and attention to detail
• Professional communication and teamwork skills
• Willingness to learn new tools and technologies
• Candidates must complete a basic JavaScript assessment with screen sharing
• The assessment must be completed independently, without AI tools or outside assistance

Preferred:
• Experience with these tools is a plus
